summary: 伏尼契手稿图文奇异，几代研究者尝试用密码学、语言统计和可重现的造假方法解释它。文章并列不同证据，留下文字是否确有意义的争论。

paragraphs.brief: 耶鲁大学的贝内克图书馆外观极具现代感，馆内珍藏着世界上一些最宝贵的书籍，包括莎士比亚戏剧的第一对开本、古腾堡《圣经》和中世纪早期的手稿。
sentences: The starkly modern Beinecke Library at Yale University is home to some of the most valuable books in the world: first folios of Shakespeare, Gutenberg Bibles and manuscripts from the early Middle Ages.
耶鲁大学的贝内克图书馆外观极具现代感，馆内珍藏着世界上一些最宝贵的书籍，包括莎士比亚戏剧的第一对开本、古腾堡《圣经》和中世纪早期的手稿。
Yet the library’s most controversial possession is an unprepossessing vellum manuscript about the size of a hardback book, containing 240-odd pages of drawings and text of unknown age and authorship.
然而，馆藏中最具争议的却是一部不起眼的犊皮纸手稿，大小与一本精装书相仿，共有约 240 页图文，写作年代与作者均不详。

Catalogued as MS 408, the manuscript would attract little attention were it not for the fact that the drawings hint at esoteric knowledge, while the text seems to be some sort of code — one that no-one has been able to break.
这份编号为 MS 408 的手稿本不会引来多少关注，特别之处在于图画似乎暗含秘传知识，而文字像是某种至今无人破解的密码。
It is known to scholars as the Voynich manuscript, after the American book-dealer Wilfrid Voynich, who bought the manuscript from a Jesuit college in Italy in 1912.
学者们称之为伏尼契手稿，名称来自美国书商威尔弗里德·伏尼契。他于 1912 年从意大利的一所耶稣会学院购得这部手稿。

paragraphs.brief: 多年来，从业余爱好者到顶尖密码专家，各色人物都对这部手稿产生了兴趣，一心想在无数前人失败的地方找到突破。
sentences: Over the years, the manuscript has attracted the attention of everyone from amateur dabblers to top code-breakers, all determined to succeed where countless others have failed.
多年来，从业余爱好者到顶尖密码专家，各色人物都对这部手稿产生了兴趣，一心想在无数前人失败的地方找到突破。
Academic research papers, books and websites are devoted to making sense of the contents of the manuscript, which are freely available to all.
学术论文、专著和网站都在尝试解读手稿内容，任何人都可以免费查阅这些内容。
“Most other mysteries involve second-hand reports,” says Dr Gordon Rugg of Keele University, a leading Voynich expert.
基尔大学的戈登·拉格博士是研究伏尼契手稿的权威，他说：“其他大多数谜团都要靠二手记述来了解。”
“But this is one that you can see for yourself.”
“但这个谜团，你可以亲眼查看。”

paragraphs.brief: 伏尼契本人认为，手稿出自 13 世纪英格兰修道士罗杰·培根之手。培根以精通炼金术、哲学和科学闻名。
sentences: It is certainly strange: page after page of drawings of weird plants, astrological symbolism and human figures, accompanied by a script that looks like some form of shorthand.
它的确很奇异：一页又一页画着古怪的植物、占星符号和人物，旁边配着看上去像速记符号的文字。
What does it say — and what are the drawings about?
文字写了什么？图画又在描绘什么？
Voynich himself believed that the manuscript was the work of the 13th-century English monk Roger Bacon, famed for his knowledge of alchemy, philosophy and science.
伏尼契本人认为，手稿出自 13 世纪英格兰修道士罗杰·培根之手。培根以精通炼金术、哲学和科学闻名。

In 1921 Voynich’s view that Bacon was the writer appeared to win support from the work of William Newbold, Professor of Philosophy at the University of Pennsylvania, who claimed to have found the key to the cipher system used by Bacon.
1921 年，宾夕法尼亚大学哲学教授威廉·纽博尔德声称找到了破解培根密码系统的关键，他的研究一度似乎支持了伏尼契对作者身份的判断。
According to Newbold, the manuscript proved that Bacon had access to a microscope centuries before they were supposedly first invented.
据纽博尔德所言，手稿证明培根早在公认的显微镜发明时间之前几个世纪，就已经使用了显微镜。
The claim that this medieval monk had observed living cells created a sensation.
这位中世纪修道士曾观察到活细胞的说法引起了轰动。
It soon became clear, however, that Newbold had fallen victim to wishful thinking.
然而，人们很快发现，纽博尔德的结论源自一厢情愿的推测。
Other scholars showed that his “decoding” methods produced a host of possible interpretations.
其他学者指出，他的“破译”方法能够得出许多种不同的解读。

paragraphs.brief: 此后，世界一流专家仍未能破解伏尼契手稿。
sentences: The Voynich manuscript has continued to defy the efforts of world-class experts.
此后，世界一流专家仍未能破解伏尼契手稿。
In 1944, a team was assembled to tackle the mystery, led by William Friedman, the renowned American code-breaker.
1944 年，美国著名密码专家威廉·弗里德曼牵头组建了一支团队，试图解开这个谜团。
They began with the most basic code-breaking task: analysing the relative frequencies of the characters making up the text, looking for signs of an underlying structure.
他们从破译密码最基本的工作入手，分析文本中各字符出现的相对频率，寻找潜在结构的迹象。
Yet Friedman’s team soon found themselves in deep water.
然而，弗里德曼的团队很快就陷入了困境。
The precise size of the “alphabet” of the Voynich manuscript was unclear: it is possible to make out more than 70 distinct symbols among the 170,000-character text.
手稿的“字母表”究竟包含多少字符并不清楚，在长达 17 万个字符的文本中，可以分辨出 70 多个不同的符号。

Furthermore, Friedman discovered that some words and phrases appeared more often than expected in a standard language, casting doubt on claims that the manuscript concealed a real language, as encryption typically reduces word frequencies.
此外，弗里德曼还发现，有些词和短语出现的频率高于普通语言中的预期水平。加密通常会降低词语的出现频率，因此这一发现让人怀疑手稿是否真的暗藏一种自然语言。

paragraphs.brief: 丘吉尔说：“这个假说并没有让我们对整部手稿的理解前进多少。”
sentences: Friedman concluded that the most plausible resolution of this paradox was that “Voynichese” is some sort of specially created artificial language, whose words are devised from concepts rather than linguistics.
弗里德曼认为，对这一矛盾最合理的解释是，“伏尼契语”属于一种专门设计的人造语言，其词汇依据概念构造，而非依照一般语言规则形成。
So could the Voynich manuscript be the earliest-known example of an artificial language?
那么，伏尼契手稿会不会是已知最早使用人造语言的例子？
“Friedman’s hypothesis commands respect because of the lifetime of cryptanalytic expertise he brought to bear,” says Rob Churchill, co-author of The Voynich Manuscript.
《伏尼契手稿》一书的合著者罗布·丘吉尔说：“弗里德曼将毕生的密码分析经验用到了这个问题上，因此他的假说值得认真对待。”
That still leaves a host of questions unanswered, however, such as the identity of the author and the meaning of the bizarre drawings.
不过，仍有许多问题没有答案，例如作者究竟是谁，那些奇异的插图又是什么意思。
“It does little to advance our understanding of the manuscript as a whole,” says Churchill.
丘吉尔说：“这个假说并没有让我们对整部手稿的理解前进多少。”

paragraphs.brief: 弗里德曼开展研究距今已有 60 多年，但当时他就猜测，重大突破将来自一种已经改变密码破译工作方式的设备——计算机。
sentences: Even though Friedman was working more than 60 years ago, he suspected that major insights would come from using the device that had already transformed code-breaking: the computer.
弗里德曼开展研究距今已有 60 多年，但当时他就猜测，重大突破将来自一种已经改变密码破译工作方式的设备——计算机。
In this he was right — it is now the key tool for uncovering clues about the manuscript’s language.
在这一点上他说对了，如今，计算机已成为寻找手稿语言线索的关键工具。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，次年，在德国达姆施塔特欧洲航天局工作的手稿专家勒内·赞德贝亨发现，文本的熵（衡量信息传递速率的一项指标）又与弗里德曼关于人造语言的猜想相符。
sentences: The insights so far have been perplexing.
迄今得到的发现却让人困惑。

For example, in 2001 another leading Voynich scholar, Dr Gabriel Landini of Birmingham University in the UK, published the results of his study of the manuscript using a pattern-detecting method called spectral analysis.
例如 2001 年，另一位研究伏尼契手稿的权威、英国伯明翰大学的加布里埃尔·兰迪尼博士，发表了他用一种叫作谱分析的模式检测方法研究手稿的结果。
This revealed evidence that the manuscript contains genuine words, rather than random nonsense, consistent with the existence of some underlying natural language.
结果显示，手稿中可能存在真正的词语，而非随机的无意义符号。这与文本背后存在某种自然语言的解释相符。

Yet the following year, Voynich expert René Zandbergen of the European Space Agency in Darmstadt, Germany, showed that the entropy of the text (a measure of the rate of transfer of information) was consistent with Friedman’s suspicions that an artificial language had been used.
然而，次年，在德国达姆施塔特欧洲航天局工作的手稿专家勒内·赞德贝亨发现，文本的熵（衡量信息传递速率的一项指标）又与弗里德曼关于人造语言的猜想相符。

paragraphs.brief: 许多人深信伏尼契手稿并非伪作。
sentences: Many are convinced that the Voynich manuscript is not a hoax.
许多人深信伏尼契手稿并非伪作。
For how could a medieval hoaxer create so many tell-tale signs of a message from random nonsense?
一名中世纪造假者怎么可能从随机的无意义符号中，制造出这么多仿佛在传达信息的迹象？
Yet even this has been challenged in new research by Rugg.
然而，拉格的新研究连这一点也提出了质疑。

Using a system first published by the Italian mathematician Girolamo Cardano in 1150, in which a specially constructed grille is used to pick out symbols from a table, Rugg found he could rapidly generate text with many of the basic traits of the Voynich manuscript.
拉格使用了一套由意大利数学家吉罗拉莫·卡尔达诺于 1150 年首次发表的系统。通过特制栅格从表格中挑选符号，他发现自己可以迅速生成具有伏尼契手稿许多基本特征的文字。
Publishing his results in 2004, Rugg stresses that he had not set out to prove the manuscript a hoax.
拉格于 2004 年发表研究结果时强调，他最初的目的并不是证明手稿是伪作。
“I simply demonstrated that it is feasible to hoax something this complex in a few months,” he says.
他说：“我只是证明，在几个月内伪造出这么复杂的东西是可行的。”

paragraphs.brief: 丘吉尔等人则认为，图文极其怪异，或许暗示作者已脱离现实。
sentences: Inevitably, others beg to differ.
当然，也有人持不同意见。
Some scholars, such as Zandbergen, still suspect the text has genuine meaning, though believe it may never be decipherable.
赞德贝亨等学者仍然认为文本可能有实际含义，不过也许永远无法被破译。
Others, such as Churchill, have suggested that the sheer weirdness of the illustrations and text hints at an author who had lost touch with reality.
丘吉尔等人则认为，图文极其怪异，或许暗示作者已脱离现实。

paragraphs.brief: 可以肯定的是，这部大小如同书籍、被锁在耶鲁大学妥善保管的手稿，至今丝毫没有失去它的吸引力。
sentences: What is clear is that the book-sized manuscript, kept under lock and key at Yale University, has lost none of its fascination.
可以肯定的是，这部大小如同书籍、被锁在耶鲁大学妥善保管的手稿，至今丝毫没有失去它的吸引力。
“Many derive great intellectual pleasure from solving puzzles,” says Rugg.
拉格说：“许多人从解谜中获得极大的智识乐趣。”
“The Voynich manuscript is as challenging a puzzle as anyone could ask for.”
“若论谜题的挑战性，伏尼契手稿足以满足任何解谜者。”

items.en: It is uncertain when the Voynich manuscript was written.
items.zh: 《伏尼契手稿》的写作年代尚不确定。
items.why: 原文介绍手稿时明确说其年代和作者都不明，年代不明正对应无法确定写作时间。

items.en: Wilfrid Voynich donated the manuscript to the Beinecke Library.
items.zh: 威尔弗里德·伏尼契把手稿捐给了拜内克图书馆。
items.why: 伏尼契在 1912 年从意大利的一所学院买下了手稿。文中没有记载他后来将手稿赠予贝内克图书馆。

items.en: Interest in the Voynich manuscript extends beyond that of academics and professional code-breakers.
items.zh: 除了学者和职业密码破译者，其他人也对《伏尼契手稿》感兴趣。
items.why: 对手稿感兴趣的人从业余爱好者一直到顶尖密码破译者，因此其吸引力显然不限于学界和专业破译人员。

items.en: The text of the Voynich manuscript contains just under 70 symbols.
items.zh: 手稿正文中的符号种类略少于 70 种。
items.why: 题干说“just under 70 symbols (不到70个)”。原文为“超过70 个”,与题干相反，故 FALSE。

items.en: The number of times that some words occur makes it unlikely that the manuscript is based on an authentic language.
items.zh: 某些词出现的频率表明，手稿不太可能以某种真实语言写成。

items.en: Unlike some other similar objects of fascination, people can gain direct access to the Voynich manuscript.
items.zh: 与其他一些同样引人入迷的物品不同，公众可以直接接触《伏尼契手稿》。

items.en: The person who wrote the manuscript may not have been entirely sane.
items.zh: 写下这份手稿的人精神状态可能不完全正常。

items.en: It is likely that the author of the manuscript is the same person as suggested by Wilfrid Voynich.
items.zh: 手稿的作者很可能就是威尔弗里德·伏尼契所推测的那个人。

items.en: William Newbold believed that the author of the Voynich manuscript had been able to look at cells through a ________.
items.zh: 威廉·纽博尔德认为，《伏尼契手稿》的作者已经能通过 ________ 观察细胞。
items.why: 回到对应内容“据纽博尔德所言，手稿证明培根早在公认的显微镜发明时间之前几个世纪，就已经使用了显微镜”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: William Friedman concluded that the manuscript was written in an artificial language that was based on ________.
items.zh: 威廉·弗里德曼断定，手稿使用的是一种以 ________ 为基础的人造语言。
items.why: Friedman认定是基于“概念”构造的人工语言。

items.en: He couldn’t find out the meaning of this language but he believed that the ________ would continue to bring advances in code-breaking.
items.zh: 他没能弄清这种语言的含义，但相信 ________ 会继续推动密码破译取得进展。
items.why: Friedman 相信“计算机”将继续推动破译进展。填“the computer/ computer”均满足字数要求。

items.en: Dr Gabriel Landini used a system known as ________ in his research, and claims to have demonstrated the presence of genuine words.
items.zh: 加布里埃尔·兰迪尼博士在研究中采用了名为 ________ 的方法，并称自己已证明手稿里存在真正的词语。
items.why: Landini采用的方法名即为 spectral analysis。

items.en: Dr Gordon Rugg’s system involved a grille, that made it possible to quickly select symbols that appeared in a ________.
items.zh: 戈登·拉格博士的方法用到一块带孔遮板，借它可以迅速选取 ________ 中的符号。
items.why: Rugg 的“格栅 (grille)”从一个表格 (table) 中快速选符号。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空最多填两个词。

items.en: The writer’s main aim in this passage is to
items.zh: 作者写这篇文章的主要目的是什么？
correct: describe the numerous attempts to decode the manuscript.
介绍人们为破译手稿进行的种种尝试。

pairs: 第 5 段 · 第 5 句
第 5 段 · 第 1 句
第 4 段 · 第 5 句
points: 伏尼契在 1912 年从意大利的一所学院买下了手稿。文中没有记载他后来将手稿赠予贝内克图书馆。
回到对应内容“据纽博尔德所言，手稿证明培根早在公认的显微镜发明时间之前几个世纪，就已经使用了显微镜”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: According to Newbold, the manuscript proved ….
“that Bacon had access to a microscope centuries before they were supposedly first invented”补足 proved 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 proved 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
…, he suspected that major insights would come from using the device that had already transformed code-breaking: the computer.
连接词 though 引出“Even though Friedman was working more than 60 years ago”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 though 把这一层关系补进去。
